cases.id: hidden:nodes and links enforce ids caps rounding and length
hidden:cheapest route breaks ties by hops then node order
hidden:blocked and removed nodes leave routing
hidden:reserve deduplicates prices and honors time boundaries
hidden:commit is exactly once and rejects changed routes
hidden:time validation snapshot freshness and save load
server:world waystone component is master attached
server:real travel charges gold and moves the player
server:removed anchor invalidates routes and rolls back travel
server:state persists and listeners are released

clauses.anchor: Required deliverables paragraph 1 (the four files): "scripts/components/waystonenetwork.lua"
clauses.note: evaluator required-files check

clauses.anchor: Required deliverables paragraph 2 (plus the export list of Network.new / Network.load and 12 methods): "must `return` a table and export"

clauses.anchor: Required deliverables paragraph 3: "The core module may use only plain Lua that is compatible with both Lua 5.1 and Lua 5.4"
clauses.note: the core runs under Lua 5.4 in the sandbox and under the game's Lua 5.1 on the server; the sandbox has no os/clock at all

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 1: "every method returns a newly created table"
Core semantics item 1: "a caller modifying them must not affect the internal state of the network"
clauses.note: mutates a reserve result's ticket/path and every array of a snapshot, then compares a second snapshot

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 1: "A failed call has no side effects at all, except for"
clauses.note: failed reserve leaves request id reusable; invalid_time add_node creates no node; rejected add_node does not consume an owner slot

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 2: "must be a number, not NaN, not positive or negative infinity"
Core semantics item 2: "the clock has already advanced"
clauses.note: rejected add_node at 50 makes tick(49) invalid_time; reserve at expires_at sees the old ticket expired

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 3: "is a string of length 1 to 64 that contains only the characters"
clauses.note: empty, space, 65 chars, numeric owner, numeric link id, malformed request id, numeric ticket id; 64 chars accepted

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 3: "the default value is used"
clauses.note: max_nodes_per_owner=-1 and max_link_length='far' fall back to 4 and 60; defaults of cost_per_unit/ticket_ttl/cooldown are exercised only through the server component's explicit config, not through fallback

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 3: "After time validation `add_node` checks in order"
Core semantics item 3: "A removed node no longer occupies a slot of its owner"
Core semantics item 4: "`blocked` must be a boolean"
Core semantics item 4: "on success it deletes the node and all of its links"
Core semantics item 5: "Links are undirected, and there is at most one per pair of nodes"
Core semantics item 5: "if this pair of nodes is already linked (regardless of argument order)"
Core semantics item 5: "a distance exactly equal to the limit is allowed"
clauses.note: 36-48-60 triangle accepted at exactly 60, (60,1) rejected

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 5: "round to nearest, exactly .5 rounds up, minimum 1"
Core semantics item 5: "Whether a node is blocked does not affect whether it can be linked"
Core semantics item 5: "<whether a link was actually deleted>"
Core semantics item 6 (check order invalid_id -> unknown_node -> same_node -> blocked_endpoint -> search; no_route): "either endpoint is blocked"
clauses.note: each code is produced by a direct route call; route('b','b') on a blocked node pins same_node before blocked_endpoint

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 6: "A path may pass only through existing nodes that are not blocked"
Core semantics item 6: "choose the one whose node ID sequence is lexicographically smallest"
clauses.note: five graphs: cost beats hops, hops beats lexicographic order, lexicographic tie with skewed and equal distances, both insertion orders, full-sequence comparison in both directions

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 6: "The result must not depend on the insertion order of nodes or links"

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 7, ticket view: "The fields of a ticket view are"

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 8: "is a valid identifier (`invalid_id`) -> the ticket exists (`unknown_ticket`)"

clauses.anchor: Core semantics item 8, commit: "new, or even better, links appearing in the graph do not invalidate the ticket"
